name: Quiz
descriptor: A question bank you author, and a run that shows one question at a time and scores the picks.
verify_checks: quiz: the score maths is emitted
pros: the questions are ordinary records, so authoring is the same form as everything else
the score is derived from the picks, not stored, so a retake is honest
the explanation is shown after the answer, which is when it is worth reading
one file: a revision aid you can carry on a phone
cons: answers are matched as text, so a typo in the spec is a wrong answer
no spaced repetition, no scheduling, no difficulty weighting
the question order is the record order
best_for: revising a fixed set of facts you wrote yourself
avoid_if: you need adaptive testing or multiple correct answers
